- [LLOG.11.8] **`withdraw` of a `logical` binding is a compile refusal.**
  `withdraw` is `scope explicit` or `internal` only ([LSCO.4.5.9]); a `logical` fact's
  lifetime belongs to its justifying activations ([LLOG.2.8.2]), and a
  refcount that decrements past the withdrawal can land on a fact no
  longer live, corrupting the truth-maintenance cascade rather than
  merely flickering.
